entities.name: Pedron
entities.description: A petty king and conqueror from Torrezon on Ixalan who stole the Immortal Sun; enemy of Elenda of Garrano.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Warrior nun who defended the Immortal Sun, survived the raid, followed it across the sea and later granted Torrezon's nobility vampirism.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Powerful artifact created by Azor, guarded by a holy order, stolen by Pedron and taken by Azor.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Great sphinx, creator of the Immortal Sun, who claimed it from Pedron.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: Despises Pedron for his betrayal and greed.

events.summary: Pedron's army raids the monastery and steals the Immortal Sun, killing most occupants.
events.quote: Pedron's army managed to steal it, killing most of the monastery's occupants.

events.summary: Azor swoops down and claims the Immortal Sun from Pedron.
events.quote: The great sphinx swooped down and claimed the Immortal Sun from Pedron's hands.

events.summary: Elenda challenges Pedron but watches the Sun carried west, and follows across the sea.
events.quote: Deciding to follow, Elenda crossed the sea after it

events.summary: Elenda returns and grants Torrezon's nobility immortality as vampirism.
events.quote: Elenda returned and granted the nobility of Torrezon the gift of immortality

relations.quote: enemy of Elenda of Garrano and her followers
